decls.statement: theorem chain_impulse_path_product (a b : ℕ → ℝ) (y₀ : ℝ) (m n : ℕ) (h : m < n) (hy : chain a b y₀ m = 0) (hb : ∀ s, m + 1 < s → s ≤ n → b s = 0) : chain a b y₀ n = (∏ k in Ico (m + 2) (n + 1), a k) * b (m + 1)

decls.name: corners_are_distinct

decls.name: contraction_path_bounded_noncommuting_witness
decls.statement: theorem contraction_path_bounded_noncommuting_witness : ‖(!![0, 1; 0, 0] : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)‖ = 1 ∧ ‖(!![0, 0; 1, 0] : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)‖ = 1 ∧ pathProdMatrixL ([!![0, 1; 0, 0], !![0, 0; 1, 0]] : List (Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)) ≠ pathProdMatrixL ([!![0, 0; 1, 0], !![0, 1; 0, 0]] : List (Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)) ∧ ‖pathProdMatrixL ([!![0, 1; 0, 0], !![0, 0; 1, 0]] : List (Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ))‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖pathProdMatrixL ([!![0, 0; 1, 0], !![0, 1; 0, 0]] : List (Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ))‖ ≤ 1

decls.name: dilation_block_eq_sigma
decls.statement: theorem dilation_block_eq_sigma {n : ℕ} (S : Fin n → ℝ) (hS0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ S i) (hS1 : ∀ i, S i ≤ 1) : ∃ D : Matrix (Fin n ⊕ Fin n) (Fin n ⊕ Fin n) ℝ, Dᵀ * D = 1 ∧ ∀ i j : Fin n, D (Sum.inl i) (Sum.inl j) = Matrix.diagonal S i j

decls.name: dilation_2x2_rotation_by_arccos
decls.statement: theorem dilation_2x2_rotation_by_arccos (S : ℝ) (hS0 : 0 ≤ S) (hS1 : S ≤ 1) : ∃ D : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ, ∃ s : ℝ, D = !![S, s; -s, S] ∧ Dᵀ * D = 1 ∧ D 0 0 = S ∧ s = Real.sqrt (1 - S ^ 2) ∧ S = Real.cos (Real.arccos S) ∧ s = Real.sin (Real.arccos S)

decls.name: dilation_gate_instance_three_five
decls.statement: theorem dilation_gate_instance_three_five : Real.sqrt (1 - (3 / 5 : ℝ) ^ 2) = 4 / 5 ∧ ((3 / 5 : ℝ)) ^ 2 + ((4 / 5 : ℝ)) ^ 2 = 1
